mechanism: Furosemide causes volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities that may increase tazarotene sensitivity and enhance retinoid-related adverse effects; tazarotene is photosensitizing and may potentiate furosemide-induced photosensitivity.
action: Monitor for photosensitivity, dehydration, and electrolyte imbalances; advise strict sun protection and adequate hydration; consider dermatology consultation if using tazarotene topically on areas of concern.
